headline: Does a FORTIFIED roof lower my mortgage payment?
body: A FORTIFIED roof doesn't change your rate, but it can lower the wind insurance in your escrow payment. How Alabama discounts and Florida wind mitigation work.
label: SWIPE

slides.h: Will a FORTIFIED roof help me qualify for a bigger loan?
slides.t: It can help a little. Lenders count your full monthly housing payment, including insurance, so a lower premium lowers your debt-to-income ratio. Use real quotes for the address, not assumptions.

slides.h: Does the FORTIFIED discount carry over when I buy the home?
slides.t: The designation stays with the home while it's current, but the discount applies to your own policy. Give the certificate to your insurer when you get quotes.

slides.h: Can I pay for a FORTIFIED roof with my home equity?
slides.t: Yes. A home equity loan, a HELOC, or a cash-out refinance can fund a roof replacement. Brian can compare them with your numbers.

headline: Why can my Florida property tax be higher than the seller's?
body: Florida resets a home's assessed value toward market value after it sells. The seller's homestead exemption and Save Our Homes cap, which limits yearly increases on a homestead to 3% or the change in inflation, whichever is less, do not transfer to you.
label: FAQ
hold_reasons: Reg Z trigger term: a percentage (rate or down payment)

facebook.text:
Let's clear this one up:

Why can my Florida property tax be higher than the seller's?

Florida resets a home's assessed value toward market value after it sells. The seller's homestead exemption and Save Our Homes cap, which limits yearly increases on a homestead to 3% or the change in inflation, whichever is less, do not transfer to you.
